metadata.name: Active Set v5.0.1 - Knowledge Graph Rebuild Vocabulary + weather_alert
metadata.description: Adds envelopevocab (canonical card envelope schema), nodevocab (9 node category taxonomy), edgevocab (canonical edge types), completenessvocab (4 tiers + per-subtype slot specs), intentvocab (watch intent modes for track segmentation), and relevancevocab (4 background relevance tiers + factor weights). Together these enable the signal→node pipeline rebuild: every signal becomes a card with consistent envelope shape, deduplicated entities, intent-driven tracking, daily chronicle generation, and visible completeness scoring.
metadata.author: ENKI System
metadata.purpose: Enable knowledge node rebuild: canonical envelope, node taxonomy, edge palette, completeness scoring, watch intents, relevance ranking
metadata.design_basis: Pressure-tested against 342 live RSS/Atom entries from 15 diverse feeds in tests/scenarios/envelope_pressuretest/. See findings.md and worked_examples/ for the corpus that drove the schema design.
metadata._activation_status: DRAFT — pending re-admission ceremony after signalvocab bump to 0.1.1 (adds signal.environmental.weather_alert).
